ShopProfile.title: ShopProfile
ShopProfile.description: Shopkeeper business profile, receipt branding, currency, tax rate, and sequential bill counter.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the shop owner.

shopName.description: Display name of the shop printed on receipts.

shopAddress.description: Shop street address printed on receipts.

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol used across prices and receipts.

taxPercent.description: Default tax percentage applied to new bills (0 to 100).

receiptFooter.description: Closing thank-you message printed at the bottom of receipts.

nextBillNumber.description: Sequential counter for generating invoice numbers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when shop profile was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Shop customer profile and cumulative spend/due ledger.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the shop owner.

totalSpent.description: Cumulative billed total for this customer.

totalDue.description: Current unpaid balance owed by this customer.

billCount.description: Total number of bills issued to this customer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when customer was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ShopProduct.title: ShopProduct
ShopProduct.description: Catalog product or service for quick billing.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the shop owner.

sku.description: Optional SKU or short item code.

unitLabel.description: Unit of measure (e.g. pcs, kg, box).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when product was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: Customer bill and digital receipt header with totals and payment status.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the shop owner.

customerId.description: Referenced Customer document ID, or empty string for Walk-in Customer.

customerName.description: Customer name snapshot printed on the receipt.

customerPhone.description: Customer phone snapshot printed on the receipt.

subtotal.description: Sum of line item totals before discount and tax.

discountAmount.description: Flat discount applied to the bill.

taxPercent.description: Tax rate percentage applied to taxable amount.

paidAmount.description: Amount paid by the customer so far.

itemCount.description: Number of line items in this bill.

itemsSummary.description: Human-readable preview of top line items.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when bill was issued (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BillLineItem.title: BillLineItem
BillLineItem.description: Individual purchased item row belonging to a Bill.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the shop owner.

productId.description: Optional catalog product ID or empty string.

unitPrice.description: Unit price at time of sale.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when line item was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Shop profile and receipt configuration scoped to each authenticated shopkeeper.

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Customer directory and credit ledger scoped to the authenticated shopkeeper.

/users/{userId}/products/{productId}.description: Shop item catalog scoped to the authenticated shopkeeper.

/users/{userId}/bills/{billId}.description: Customer bills and digital receipts scoped to the authenticated shopkeeper.

/users/{userId}/bills/{billId}/items/{it.description: Itemized line items belonging to a customer bill.
